enable_after: compatible API, packing supervisor and client
api_instance_billing: Keep request billing at quiet traffic; compare measured sustained traffic before enabling

logging_exclusion.name: bmt-sampled-success-requests
logging_exclusion.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="bmt-api" AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/requests") AND httpRequest.status>=200 AND httpRequest.status<400 AND NOT sample(insertId,0.01)

storage.cleanup: Reference/pin-aware candidate GC, pack compaction and delayed retirement
storage.soft_delete_and_versioning: Inspect actual retained copies and backup protection before changing provider policy

commitments: No purchases until a sustained measured baseline exists
development_resources: Retain active work; use ownership/expiry labels and current retain-data guards for eventual cleanup
spot_capacity: Optional separate workers for checkpointed offline rebuilds only; not intake, database or timely result acceptance
certification: Local implementation profile, not demonstrated one-million-DAU capacity or a bill ceiling
